# Records Research Group

> Independent, non-commercial public-records accessibility research.
> Measures the gap between Oregon public-bodies' stated records
> obligations and their observed handling of requests — fees,
> channels, waivers, productions, nonresponses, petitions. Oregon
> Public Records Law (ORS 192.311 et seq.) scope, Oct–Nov 2026;
> federal FOIA variant at a small federal set. All outputs CC0.

## Reading order for a researcher

1. findings/ — eight documented findings, each formatted
   claim / stated obligation / observed behavior / witnesses /
   what-this-does-not-establish / status, with anchor links
   (#f1..#f8) into the scoreboard rows that witness them.
2. scoreboard.html — per-request ledger, 163 filed requests across
   130 bodies, with stable row anchors (#rrg-01..#rrg-165).
3. requests/ — permanent per-request pages for portal-ticketed
   threads: scope, correspondence timeline, fee math, status.
4. notes/ — longer-form research notes (Lane County study,
   Wellpath contract, housing-response spend).
5. data/ — machine-readable datasets (CSV).

## Datasets

- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/accessibility_scoreboard.csv — request ledger
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/findings.csv — finding index
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/wellpath_57233_contract_ladder.csv — contract instrument ladder
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/lane_county_housing_response_rollup.csv — spend rollup
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/or_invisibility_index.csv — FAC-derived index
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/or_dhs_fy2024_vendors_fac.csv — FAC vendor data
- https://records-research-group.github.io/data/or_muni_fac_overlay.csv — municipal FAC overlay
- DOI deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23904505

## Usage notes

- Quotes in request-page timelines are from agency correspondence;
  primary correspondence is held in an internal archive and is
  public-record in principle at each body.
- Findings explicitly list what the evidence does NOT establish;
  prefer citing a finding's non-claims alongside its claim.
- Attribution/CC0: free reuse; cite the page URL + as-of date.
